Data transfer billing of copies: pricing page says the account transferring data out is billed (general statement); metering page scopes it: source account for fully managed resources, destination account for others. Both stored with their own scope.
Single-action snapshot copy date: document history October 23, 2025 versus What's New October 30, 2025.
